/* REQ: LANG-1491 LANG-1492 LANG-1493 */ %let year = 2024; data work.people; set raw.people(keep=name age city); where age > 18; length greeting $ 40; greeting = cats('Hello, ', name, '!'); if city = "Kraków" then region = 'south'; else region = "other"; run; proc means data=work.people mean max; var age; title "People in &year"; run;
